lessonRef.title: Assessment preparation: chords, radii, tangents, and the inscribed right angle

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: An inscribed angle in a circle intercepts an arc of 116°. Find the measure of the inscribed angle.
A circle has radius 5. From an external point 13 from the centre, a tangent is drawn. Find the length of the tangent segment, and state the fact that makes this possible.
choices: 12, because the tangent bisects the radius
8, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency
12, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency
18, because the tangent extends beyond the circle

items.prompt: A circle has radius 6. Find the arc length and the sector area for a central angle of 30°, in terms of π.
choices: arc 3π; sector 1π
arc 1π; sector 6π
arc 1/2π; sector 3π
arc 1π; sector 3π

items.prompt: A quadrilateral is inscribed in a circle. One angle measures 103°. Find the measure of the opposite angle.
An inscribed angle in a circle intercepts an arc of 86°. Find the measure of the inscribed angle.
A circle has radius 8. From an external point 17 from the centre, a tangent is drawn. Find the length of the tangent segment, and state the fact that makes this possible.
choices: 25, because the tangent extends beyond the circle
15, because the tangent bisects the radius
15, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency
9, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency

items.prompt: A circle has radius 11. Find the arc length and the sector area for a central angle of 90°, in terms of π.
choices: arc 11/4π; sector 121/4π
arc 11/2π; sector 121/4π
arc 11/2π; sector 121/2π
arc 121/4π; sector 11/2π

items.prompt: A quadrilateral is inscribed in a circle. One angle measures 119°. Find the measure of the opposite angle.
